rows.kicked-any-number-of-targets: CR 702.33d/601.2c: kicked, 'any number of target creatures you control gain indestructible instead'; both named creatures should have indestructible. Observed: the kicked cast poses no target choice at all and resolves doing nothing (neither creature gains indestructible). The unkicked single-target mode works (its scenarios pass). Confidence high. New root, found by the FDN audit batch 6; no ticket yet.
rows.kicked-targets-survive-a-wrath: Same root as kicked-any-number-of-targets: the kicked cast gives nothing indestructible, so Day of Judgment destroys the two creatures that should have survived (only the untargeted Hill Giant should die).
